verdict.rationale: Clara is a spend-management platform that advertises automated expense reporting, approvals, card configurations and an API, so asking whether automations can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence describes version history, change review, or rollback for automations, rules, or configurations. Card configuration updates and sandbox testing are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
